scenes.tts: Two monkeyflowers can be crossed by hand to give hybrid seed. One has pink flowers, visited mostly by bumblebees. The other has red flowers, visited mostly by hummingbirds. Yet the barriers measured between them were estimated to block, on average, ninety-nine point eight seven percent of gene flow. What holds them apart?
scenes.visual: Pink and red flower silhouettes with a hand-cross arrow and hybrid seed; the 99.87% appears in the gap, then three question-mark boxes.

scenes.tts: A reproductive barrier is anything that reduces gene flow between populations. Barriers are sorted by when they act. Where the plants grow, and which pollinators visit them, act before the zygote, the fertilized egg. Low fertility in the hybrids acts after a hybrid zygote forms. One pair of species can be held apart by several barriers at once.
scenes.visual: The question boxes become three barrier chips; a dashed zygote line splits before from after; the chips are named and sorted.
scenes.narration: A reproductive barrier is anything that reduces gene flow between populations. Barriers are sorted by when they act. Where the plants grow, and which pollinators visit them, act before the zygote, the fertilized egg. Low fertility in the hybrids acts after a hybrid zygote forms. One pair of species can be held apart by several barriers at once.

scenes.tts: Barriers act in sequence. Each one works only on the gene flow that the earlier barriers left behind. These numbers are illustrative, in the style of the monkeyflower study. Call the fraction of the remaining gene flow that a barrier blocks its R I. A barrier's credit is the gene flow it blocks. The first barrier, ecogeographic, has an R I of zero point six. It gets credit of zero point six, and zero point four of the gene flow is left.
scenes.visual: The chips rise to gate positions; a band of gene flow of 1.00 runs in and the first gate closes on it, leaving 0.40; the credit bar starts.
scenes.caption: Barriers act in sequence. Each one works only on the gene flow that the earlier barriers left behind. These numbers are illustrative, in the style of the monkeyflower study. Call the fraction of the remaining gene flow that a barrier blocks its RI. A barrier's credit is the gene flow it blocks. The first barrier, ecogeographic, has an RI of 0.60. It gets credit of 0.60, and 0.40 of the gene flow is left.

scenes.tts: The pollinator barrier has an R I of zero point nine. But it acts only on the zero point four that is left. It blocks zero point three six. Then hybrid fertility, with an R I of zero point five, acts on the zero point zero four that remains. It blocks zero point zero two.
scenes.visual: Second gate closes on the 0.40 band (0.90 x 0.40 = 0.36), third on 0.04 (0.50 x 0.04 = 0.02); the credit bar fills.
scenes.caption: The pollinator barrier has an RI of 0.90. But it acts only on the 0.40 that is left. It blocks 0.36. Then hybrid fertility, with an RI of 0.50, acts on the 0.04 that remains. It blocks 0.02.
scenes.narration: The pollinator barrier has an RI of 0.90. But it acts only on the 0.40 that is left. It blocks 0.36. Then hybrid fertility, with an RI of 0.50, acts on the 0.04 that remains. It blocks 0.02.

scenes.tts: Total isolation is one minus what gets through. Multiply what each barrier lets through: zero point four, times zero point one, times zero point five. That is zero point zero two. So total isolation is zero point nine eight. Do not add the raw strengths. They sum to two, which means nothing as a fraction of gene flow.
scenes.visual: Formula 1 - 0.40 x 0.10 x 0.50 = 0.98 with a green total on the credit bar; then the raw sum 2.00 appears struck out.
scenes.caption: Total isolation is one minus what gets through. Multiply what each barrier lets through: 0.40 times 0.10 times 0.50. That is 0.02. So total isolation is 0.98. Do not add the raw strengths. They sum to 2.00, which means nothing as a fraction of gene flow.

scenes.tts: Now swap the first two barriers. The pollinator barrier acts first and gets zero point nine of the credit. The ecogeographic barrier gets only zero point zero six. Hybrid fertility still gets zero point zero two. The total is still zero point nine eight. A barrier can only block the gene flow left for it, so credit depends on position as well as strength. Barriers act on what remains, so order moves the credit, not the total.
scenes.visual: The first two gates swap; the band and credit bar re-form: 0.90, 0.06, 0.02; the total stays 0.98.
